title: Tally's updates walk on the phone without TJ asking from the phone first: relay updates, session questions and reviews triggered from the laptop or a session are walked like replies to phone messages

requirements.text: A Tally reply to a relay, session question or laptop message that carries an items block is walked on the phone, not logged as not walked

text: Bridge: walkable() now walks any reply with an items block whatever began the turn (laptop replies without a block are shown only; empty block never walks); 55/55 tests.
